registration.note: this supplement adds measurements inside the registered level-1 window; the escalation verdict stays with b4_data_probe_prereg_20261027 and is not re-read here

question_zh: 在 132 个交易日窗口（2023-04-14..2023-10-31）上，同配方单条连续轨迹在 1.32/2.64 个有效 epoch 点的样本外 RankIC 各是多少，峰值落在哪个训练量上。
hypothesis: if the out-of-sample RankIC peak moves to a larger training amount when the window holds more days, the training-amount optimum is data-limited; if the peak stays at the smallest amount, more data does not support more training.

factor.changed: none beyond the training amount of one continuous trajectory
factor.note: no data, label, split or model setting differs from the frozen recipe of this rung

environment_only_changes.data.cache_dir: host cache root (shared across the seeds of this rung)
